title: Apply the P02 re-qualification runbook to the operating database

source.execution_instruction: Owner answer 'Approve rollout' in this session to the question 'Approve applying the runbook to the operating database?', after the second rehearsal on a restored copy was reported

authorizes: a manual admin backup and a logical dump with a verified restore check before any operating write
pausing scheduled writers by stopping the API process for the rollout window
history_requalification p02-history-requalification-v2 (dry run, then apply) on the operating database
restarting the API on the ft/p02-remediation build and rebuilding context reports through the existing worklist and the paced pre-policy backfill
the integrity audit and affected-forecast inventory on the operating database after the apply
requires: the stop conditions of the runbook: unchanged preservation hashes, no missing or mismatched retained files, no apply errors, and a reconciled set and qualified count equal to the dry run
no change to any published forecast, artifact, read report or prior history decision
explicitly_not_authorized: editing, superseding, hiding or re-scoring forecasts, or populating the Option B annotation (separate decision)
provider acquisition, identity admissions or resolutions, and the P09-01 phases
supersession: Lifts, for this runbook only, the operating-write exclusion of AUTHORIZE_UNIFIED_P02_DATA_INTEGRITY_IMPLEMENTATION_V1. All its other exclusions stay in force.
